text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waah~ Looks delicious!
Time to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*slurp*... Mmmph!?
Wh-What in tarnation is this~!!!

During training, there was something
off about Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*... Chashu measurement complete.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
After this... 10 ramen dashes...
I have to get... seconds too...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! I-I'm so sorry!
Did I say something strange?

"...Perhaps she was just exhausted.
Worried, I asked her for more details—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's right...! That shop
has been getting a toootal amount of attention
among ramen connoisseurs, you see――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Noodles bursting with rich wheat flavor, a deep tonkotsu broth,
and chashu that melts in your mouth effortlessly...
It was truly a life-changing bowl of tonkotsu ramen!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~...
I really wanna eat that place's ramen again~...
choice_data_list: Want to go grab a bite for now?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No... It's just, it takes about two hours
and multiple train transfers to get there...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm alright!
I'll get myself pumped back up and do my best!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Tonkotsu... A rich harmony of broth and thin noodles.
Adding an extra noodle refill and a seasoned boiled egg... ehehe.

I never thought ramen would consume her mind to this extent.
If it's come to this...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? We're making it!?
Instead of going out to eat?
choice_data_list: I figured that would be better for the future.

text_block_list.text: If I can recreate the restaurant's flavor once, I should be able to whip it up quickly whenever she craves it again.

"...Of course, making restaurant-quality ramen
won't be easy. However—
with her deep passion for food, we can do it!"
choice_data_list: I'm sure you can make something you're satisfied with!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Understood! If that's the case...
I'll do my best to recreate that flavor!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm.
Feels like something's missing...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I tried putting my own spin on tonkotsu ramen,
but... it feels like it still hasn't quite reached that flavor.
choice_data_list: I'll need more information to recreate it.
We'll need more information to recreate it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're right! In that case,
let's start by gathering information!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know that ramen shop too!
It's that Hakata-style tonkotsu place, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The garlic packs a punch, and I love that~!
I wonder if that's how they get rid of the pork bone gaminess?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Also, the way they prep the pork bones is so thorough~.
If we learn from that, it'll definitely be buono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Making dashi stock takes time, so using a pressure cooker might be the way to go~!
Do your best, Spe-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see...!
Thank you both for the information!

text_block_list.name: Butcher Shop Guy
text_block_list.text:
Pork shoulder roast? Perfect timing!
We just got in some top-quality cuts!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yay! Then, um... I'll also have pork spine and pig's trotters, please!

text_block_list.name: Butcher Shop Guy
text_block_list.text:
Pork spine and trotters too?
Spe-chan, what in the world are you making?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That one seems a bit different in color, maybe?
The shape of the bowl was pretty much like that, though.
choice_data_list: Wait, you're matching the bowls too!?
Wait, you're matching the bowls too!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If it's come to this, I'll go all the way!
I want to pursue the ramen from that shop to perfection!

As for me, I would have been satisfied just making
something she could accept to some extent, but...
choice_data_list: You don't need to obsess over every little detail, you know?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No! If anything, I'm the one who wants to be particular about this!
Please let me do it, Trainer!

It seems her inquisitive spirit has been set ablaze.
And so, pursuing inquiry after inquiry led to—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-It's ready~! I call it:
"A Bowl Recreating the Taste of That Famous Shop"!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Well then, time to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ngh!? E-Even if I don't measure up...
I can still be satisfied! I totally can!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Paying attention to every little detail really paid off!
Mmm, delicious~!"
choice_data_list: All that hard work paid off, huh.
All that hard work paid off, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm so happy I was able to recreate
that flavor I love so much!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Here, Trainer, you eat some too!
It's not quite a perfect recreation of the restaurant's flavor, though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It turned out quite delicious, so please, have some!

Taking up the offer, I slurped the freshly prepared ramen.
—My eyes went wide without realizing it.
choice_data_list: Delicious! It tastes just like a professional made it!
Delicious! It tastes just like a professional made it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I'm so glad it suited your taste!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right! Once I finish eating this,
I'm gonna train with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Can I just order an extra serving of noodles?
